g.text: Operations and their operands — datasets, selections, combinations
DECLARED IN THE REPO (authority flows outward from here)
PRODUCED RECORDS — append-only, keyed by combination

text.tspan: DRAW
Pick the instances for a selection (filter + seed)
and save the list. Every model runs this same list,
so results are comparable across models.
RESOLVE
Look up the current digest of each instance's Docker
image and record it. Future runs use these exact
images even if the publisher re-tags them.
ENSURE
Check local Docker has the recorded digests.
Pull missing ones. Stop on a mismatch —
that needs a decision, not an auto-fix.
RUN
Run the agent against each instance in its container;
save the patch, trajectory, and API traffic.
The only step that calls the API (costs money).
MARK
Apply each saved patch in a fresh container and run
that instance's tests. Resolved = the failing tests
now pass and the passing ones still do.
AUDIT
Compare outputs against the selection: every instance
has a trajectory and a verdict, no error exits.
Fails loudly if anything is missing.
ANALYSE
Compute per model: resolve rate from verdicts, cost and
steps from trajectories, thinking from the API traffic.
Writes analysis/<dataset>.json and .md.

g.text: Every operation is a function of declared inputs. draw/resolve are the only ones allowed to consult the outside world, and each writes a committed declaration. ensure is the only one that changes machine state. run is the only one that spends. Nothing downstream of a record can alter it. Comparing a control with its variation = comparing two combinations' records over the same selection.
DATASET — facts about a world, independent of any run
SELECTION — named frozen subset of one dataset
COMBINATION — one visit: selection × model × knobs
run record: patches + trajectories + wire capture
marker: what produces a verdict, how invoked
agent environment shape: workdir, entrypoint, startup

text.tspan: model, effort, workers, prompt/timeout configs;
its name keys all outputs (runs/<name>/, evals/, logs/)
SEVERAL combinations may visit the SAME selection
with different knobs — that is a control and its variation.
Same instances, same marker: only the knobs differ.
selection multilingual/cpp:
the same 11 fmt instances, frozen once
combination 'multilingual' (control)
default prompt · 60s actions
→ runs/multilingual/
combination 'fmt-variation'
verify-your-work prompt · 900s actions
→ runs/fmt-variation/

g.text: pull by digest, verify, refuse on mismatch
gates: no analysis from incomplete records
